summary: Resumed task 430 at phase 3. Completed Phase 3 (reinstated the generalized V4 copy channel, an atomic-batch revert of a70187dd's removal) and Phase 4 (proved copy-completeness at a genuine applyAllTImpRules fixpoint over raw edges, two new sorry-free axiom-clean lemmas). Both phases fully CI-verified and committed. Phase 5 (thread and export the persistence invariant over augmented edges) was investigated in depth but not completed: found that the raw-edge half of the goal is cheaply derivable from already-threaded invariants (IAllUniv/IAllFuel) plus the new Phase 4 lemmas, but the augmented-edge loop-back transfer -- the phase's actual goal -- requires a genuine IWorldHist-style origin-tracing extension, independently confirmed by direct inspection of the live reuse-site code, comparable in scope to building IWorldHist itself. No Cslib/ writes were made for Phase 5; the tree is exactly as Phase 4 left it. Phases 6-8 remain NOT STARTED, blocked on Phase 5's export.

blockers.description: Augmented-edge persistence export requires an IWorldHist-style origin-tracing extension (tracking, for every positive formula's branch presence, a traceable point of origin, and showing that origin is raw-accessible to any loop-back edge's source). genCopies only propagates along raw edges (Expansion.lean), and the reuse site's Sfor-containment fact (Expansion.lean:321-339, consumed at the loop-back edge insertion in Scheme.lean's key induction) only covers formulas known at the moment of the reuse decision, not formulas arriving later. This is a genuine, sizeable engineering task, not a one-line corollary -- comparable to the multi-phase effort that built IWorldHist itself.
